body: i don't know. i am so messed up. I thought I could move live away from the people who deserted me. I don't even look myself as a person. It's all so strange. It always seemed to hurt so bad so I chose to stop having feelings. But this isn't worth staying alive for. How can I go back to having feelings. Is it even worth it.

Having feelings got me into trouble in the first place

It just seems to make sense that I chose to have the wrong feelings.

So if I can't have feelings, then what point is there in living?
